text:
Introduction
This document details the check list, which should be carried out on a weekly, monthly 
bases and every three months bases as indicated by W1, M1, M3 in the title block.
This first draft is initiated by eng. Samy Mohamed Hassan, tested by eng. Al 
Sayed mahmoud El-Ashry at 20 Jan 2004, revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control eng. Tawfeq El-abasey, accepted by 
general manager eng. Mohamed Abd Elghaffar, and certified by eng. Moustafa 
Al Lethy; EDEPCo. Inspection & QC head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear protective safety helmet, shoes, safety clothes, goggles, and rubber 
 gloves.
Tools and
Equipment
Safety 
 helmet, shoes,
Hydrometer,
 Digital voltmeter
Thermometer,
 Filler.
Important Notes
When cells are supplied filled with acid they must be placed on float charge 
 or given an equalizing or freshening charge within 90 days from the date of 
 shipment.
Never add acid to increase specific gravity readings.
Gases given off by batteries on charge are explosive!
Don't smoke or permit open flames near batteries or do anything to cause 
 sparks.
The room in which the battery is installed should be well ventilated and its 
 temperature as moderate as the climate will allow.
The temperature of the electrolyte should preferably never exceed 38 
 OC.
Keep containers, lids and battery rooms perfectly clean.
Wipe out salt and acid stains on terminals, connections and lids with a 
 wet sponge.
Never clean containers and lids with solvents, detergents, oil or similar 
 products.
Wash caps water and dry them before putting them back on the battery.
Monthly
Check total voltage at battery terminals. It must equal: N * U
 - N = number of battery cells
 - U = floating voltage per cell to be applied according to cell type and 
 annual average room temperature.
Measure voltage, specific gravity and temperature of a few reference 
 cells.
Check electrolyte levels.
Measure room temperature.
Quarterly (every 3 months)
Measure total voltage of battery and ambient temperature.
Measure all cells voltages.
Measure specific gravity of a few cells with varying voltages as well as 
 electrolyte level and temperature.
Apply equalizing charge.

When adding water, never exceed maximum level.
